root_idea.summary: The root centers on an open area or expanse associated with a house or settlement.
root_idea.development: The lexical range extends from a house's open court or yard to a spacious area among dwellings and, more broadly, to a side, quarter, region, or territory.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic noun is presented under its normalized Classical Arabic citation form سَاحَة.

senses.definition: A side, quarter, region, or territory; in بِسَاحَتِهِمْ, the area or territory of a people.
senses.usage_conditions: Quran-attested in a possessive expression referring to the area or territory associated with a people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An open court, yard, or unbuilt area of a house; more broadly, a spacious area among dwellings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes an unbuilt or roofless part of a house, its yard, and a broad open place among a community's dwellings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In بَرِيءُ السَّاحَةِ, free from accusation or blame; innocent.
